gloss: to take advantage of; to exploit

definitions.gloss: to take advantage of, to exploit
definitions.explanation: To exploit someone's weakness, kindness, or a situation for one's own benefit. Carries a negative connotation of unfair or opportunistic behavior.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む。
{優|やさ}しさに{付|つ}け{込|こ}まれて、{断|ことわ}れなかった。
examples.english: Someone took advantage of my kindness and I couldn't refuse.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{不注意|ふちゅうい}に{付|つ}け{込|こ}んで、{一気|いっき}に{攻|せ}めた。
examples.english: I seized on my opponent's carelessness and launched an all-out attack.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
- {付|つ}け{込|こ}まない（{否定|ひてい}）
- {付|つ}け{込|こ}みます（{丁寧|ていねい}）
- {付|つ}け{込|こ}んで（て{形|けい}）
- {付|つ}け{込|こ}んだ（{過去|かこ}）

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to take advantage of ~
- {弱|よわ}みに{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit a weakness
- {隙|すき}に{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to exploit an opening
- {善意|ぜんい}に{付|つ}け{込|こ}む: to take advantage of goodwill

NOTE: Not to be confused with {漬|つ}け{込|こ}む (to pickle, to marinate), which is a homophone with a completely different meaning.
